in_line: Management reaffirmed its expectation of sequential unit growth, guiding for 20-plus units in each of Q3 and Q4.

surprises.description: Xos cut its 2026 outlook, lowering full-year guidance to revenue of $35–43 million, 250–350 unit deliveries, and a non-GAAP operating loss of $11.4–13.7 million. Management attributed the reduction to deliveries shifting into future quarters.
surprises.fact_evidence: Management “cut full-year 2026 guidance” to revenue of $35–43 million, unit deliveries of 250–350 units, and non-GAAP operating loss of $11.4–13.7 million, reflecting shifted delivery timing.
surprises.expectation_evidence: The call describes the full-year guidance as having been “cut,” indicating the prior guidance was higher; it does not state the prior figures.

surprises.description: SoundThinking cut 2026 revenue guidance to $99–100 million from $109–111 million, a reduction of about $10 million. Management attributed roughly 70% of the cut to timing and pushouts into 2027 and 30% to slower sales growth.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $109-111 million to $99-100 million, a roughly $10 million reduction,” with “about 70% attributed to timing/pushouts into 2027 and 30% to slower sales growth.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: Prior full-year 2026 revenue guidance was “$109-111 million.”

surprises.description: Q2 revenue was about $2 million below the company’s $25.9 million half-year pacing target, coming in at $23.9 million.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Q2 2026 revenue fell to $23.9 million” and missed the “$25.9 million half-year pacing target by about $2 million.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The company’s “$25.9 million half-year pacing target.”

surprises.description: SoundThinking reduced full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 8–9%. The call says guidance was reduced but does not provide the prior margin range, so the size of the change cannot be established from these facts.
surprises.fact_evidence: “Full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance was reduced to 8-9%.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The call says full-year adjusted EBITDA margin guidance “was reduced,” but gives no prior range.

surprises.description: The roughly $1.5 million Puerto Rico ShotSpotter contract recapture was removed entirely from 2026 guidance, eliminating revenue that had been expected in the year.
surprises.fact_evidence: “The Puerto Rico ShotSpotter contract recapture (originally ~$1.5 million) was removed entirely from 2026 guidance.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: The Puerto Rico contract recapture was included in 2026 guidance before being “removed entirely.”

surprises.description: SafePointe deployment delays reduced expected revenue by about $2 million, despite nearly 90 new lanes being booked in Q2.
surprises.fact_evidence: “SafePointe deployment delays reduced expected revenue by about $2 million despite nearly 90 new lanes booked in Q2.”
surprises.expectation_evidence: Expected SafePointe revenue was about $2 million higher before the deployment delays.

in_line: Management reaffirmed ARR growth from $95.4 million to over $100 million entering 2027.
2026 guidance assumes no revenue contribution from a renewed Chicago ShotSpotter contract.
